/- Let $R$ be a ring with $1 \neq 0$.\nFor two elements $a,b \in R$, if $1-ab$ is a unit,
then $1-ba$ is a unit. -/
theorem isUnit_one_sub_mul {R : Type} [Ring R] [Nontrivial R] {a b : R} (h : IsUnit (1 - a * b)) :
    IsUnit (1 - b * a) := by
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := h
  set u : R := ((v⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) with hu_def
  have hu1 : (1 - a * b) * u = 1 := by
    rw [← hv]; exact v.mul_inv
  have hu2 : u * (1 - a * b) = 1 := by
    rw [← hv]; exact v.inv_mul
  have habu : a * b * u = u - 1 := by
    have h' : u - a * b * u = 1 := by
      have := hu1
      rw [sub_mul, one_mul] at this
      exact this
    have : a * b * u = u - 1 := by
      have eq : a * b * u = u - (u - a * b * u) := by abel
      rw [eq, h']
    exact this
  have huab : u * a * b = u - 1 := by
    have h' : u - u * (a * b) = 1 := by
      have := hu2
      rw [mul_sub, mul_one] at this
      exact this
    have h'' : u * (a * b) = u - 1 := by
      have eq : u * (a * b) = u - (u - u * (a * b)) := by abel
      rw [eq, h']
    rw [mul_assoc]; exact h''
  refine ⟨⟨1 - b * a, 1 + b * u * a, ?_, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
  · have e1 : (1 - b * a) * (1 + b * u * a) = 1 + b * u * a - b * a - b * a * (b * u * a) := by
      noncomm_ring
    rw [e1]
    have step : b * a * (b * u * a) = b * (u - 1) * a := by
      have h1 : b * a * (b * u * a) = b * (a * b * u) * a := by noncomm_ring
      rw [h1, habu]
    rw [step]
    have h2 : b * (u - 1) * a = b * u * a - b * a := by noncomm_ring
    rw [h2]
    abel
  · have e1 : (1 + b * u * a) * (1 - b * a) = 1 - b * a + b * u * a - b * u * a * (b * a) := by
      noncomm_ring
    rw [e1]
    have step : b * u * a * (b * a) = b * (u - 1) * a := by
      have h1 : b * u * a * (b * a) = b * (u * a * b) * a := by noncomm_ring
      rw [h1, huab]
    rw [step]
    have h2 : b * (u - 1) * a = b * u * a - b * a := by noncomm_ring
    rw [h2]
    abel

/-- Let $S$ be any ring and let $n>2$ be an integer.
Propose a proof that if $A$ is any strictly upper triangular matrix in $M_n(S)$, then $A^n = 0$.
(A strictly upper triangular matrix is one whose entries on and below the main diagonal are all
zero.) -/
theorem pow_eq_zero_of_strictly_upper_triangle {S : Type} [Ring S] (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 < n)
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) S) (hA : ∀ (i : Fin n), ∀ (j : Fin n), i ≥ j → A i j = 0) :
    A ^ n = 0 := by
  have key : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ i j : Fin n, (j : ℕ) < (i : ℕ) + k → (A ^ k) i j = 0 := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro i j hij
      simp only [Nat.add_zero, pow_zero] at *
      have hne : i ≠ j := by
        intro h
        rw [h] at hij
        exact lt_irrefl _ hij
      simp [Matrix.one_apply, hne]
    | succ k ih =>
      intro i j hij
      rw [pow_succ, Matrix.mul_apply]
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro l _
      by_cases hl : (l : ℕ) < (i : ℕ) + k
      · rw [ih i l hl]
        simp
      · push_neg at hl
        have hjl : (j : ℕ) ≤ (l : ℕ) := by
          have : (j : ℕ) ≤ (i : ℕ) + k := by
            have := hij
            omega
          exact le_trans this hl
        have hlj : l ≥ j := hjl
        rw [hA l j hlj]
        simp
  ext i j
  rw [Matrix.zero_apply]
  apply key n i j
  have hjn : (j : ℕ) < n := j.isLt
  omega

theorem real_algEquiv_eq_one (f : ℝ ≃ₐ[ℚ] ℝ) : f = 1 := by
  -- Step 1: f preserves nonneg
  have h_nonneg : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → 0 ≤ f x := by
    intro x hx
    have hsq : x = Real.sqrt x ^ 2 := (Real.sq_sqrt hx).symm
    calc 0 ≤ f (Real.sqrt x) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
      _ = f (Real.sqrt x ^ 2) := by rw [map_pow]
      _ = f x := by rw [← hsq]
  -- Step 2: f is strictly monotone
  have h_mono : StrictMono (f : ℝ → ℝ) := by
    intro a b hab
    have hba : (0 : ℝ) ≤ b - a := by linarith
    have h1 : 0 ≤ f (b - a) := h_nonneg _ hba
    have h2 : f (b - a) = f b - f a := map_sub f b a
    have h3 : 0 ≤ f b - f a := by rw [← h2]; exact h1
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le h3 with hlt | heq
    · linarith
    · exfalso
      have hfeq : f b = f a := by linarith
      have hab' : b = a := f.injective hfeq
      linarith
  -- Step 3: rational values
  have h_rat : ∀ q : ℚ, f (q : ℝ) = (q : ℝ) := by
    intro q
    have h := f.commutes q
    simpa using h
  -- Step 4: conclude
  apply AlgEquiv.ext
  intro x
  show f x = x
  by_contra hne
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hlt | hgt
  · -- f x < x
    obtain ⟨q, hq1, hq2⟩ := exists_rat_btwn hlt
    have hm := h_mono hq2
    rw [h_rat q] at hm
    linarith
  · -- x < f x
    obtain ⟨q, hq1, hq2⟩ := exists_rat_btwn hgt
    have hm := h_mono hq1
    rw [h_rat q] at hm
    linarith
